No. 1966/21 – WEDNESDAY, MAY, 11, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: අǩ/4/5/3/7/6. Reference No.of the Ministry of Lands: 4/3/9/2012/WS/252.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:-

The allotment of land called “Rambewakele” in total extent of about 0.4856 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 718 in Final Village Plan No. 157, Suppliment No. 29, Sheet No. 31, dated on 28.01.2016, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Rambewa in Kende Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Rambewa in Anuradhapura District, North Central Province and bounded as follows:
Lot No. 718 — Name of the Land: Rambewa kele; Name and Address of the claimants: Mrs.Thuduvage jain Nona, No. 251, Mihintale Road, Rambewa.; Extent of the Land: 0.4856 Hectares.
Boundaries:
North: Lot No. 226 ; East: Lot No. 225; South: Lot No.719; West: Lot No. 227.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Rambewa on the 8th day of June 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20th day of May 2016, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. A. M. W. A AMMUNUGAMA, Divisional Secretary, Rambewa. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Rambewa, 03rd May, 2016. 05 - 841

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
Description of the land to be acquired:-

The allotment of land called “Galhenakanda Mukalana” in total extent of about 0.0759 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 123 in Final Village Plan No. 568, Suppliment No. 5, Sheet No. 6, dated on 24.02.2016, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Handapangala in Udukaha Korale West, Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Narammala in Kurunegala District, North - Western Province and bounded as follows. Lot No. 123 — Name of the Land: Galhenakanda Mukalana; Name and Address of the claimants: Mr. Ranasinghe Mudiyanselage Abeysinghe, (Expired) Near Puhule Wihara junction, Handapangala, Giriulla. & Others. Extent of the Land: 0.0759 Hectares.
Boundaries: North: Lot No. 32 ; East: Lot No. 122; South: Lot No.122 & Lot No. 124 ; West: Lot No. 124.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretary’s Office, at Narammala on the 03rd day of August 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th day of July 2016, the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
M. A. R. SUDARSHANI, Divisional Secretary, Narammala Division. Divisional Secretariat, Narammala Division, 06th May, 2016. 05 - 847
